parameters.name: MachineTypes
parameters.description:
The type of the asset to query. If no asset types are specified, all types of assets are returned. Valid values:

*   **ecs**: server
*   **cloud_product**: Alibaba Cloud service

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the asset resides.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The ID of the primary account of the Resource Directory member account.
> call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) interface to obtain this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-field-statistics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --machine-types ecs --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
